agent_explanation: EW direction green exceeds max_green_seconds 47 and stays green continuously from ~570 to 767 while detector_fail on W is active from 610 onward. Because max_green is not enforced when detector is failed (or the controller thinks no demand / queue invisible interfers with gap-out logic) the EW phase never terminates, so NS approaches wait 201s at red with queues >100, exceeding 200s limit. Removing the detector_fail makes the scenario pass, confirming max_green bypass during detector failure.
